structured_output.summary: The change implements getUTCSeconds as the spec describes. It gets the time value with `this_time_value(agent, this)?`, which should cover RequireInternalSlot and read [[DateValue]], so a TypeError propagates. It returns NaN when tv is NaN, and otherwise returns `sec_from_time(tv)`. Every spec step has a comment above its code. Nothing is hardcoded or special-cased, and no errors are swallowed. The test262 target went from 8 to 16 passing, with no regressions. I could not open the helper source because the shell was disabled in this session. I judged the helpers `this_time_value` and `sec_from_time` only from the diff and the passing gate report.
